assignments.node_id: היא ראמת שבעין קלין, כיולדת שקדם הלדה היא צועקת שבעין קלין (זהר פינחס רמ"ט:), כנגד שבעין תבין שבמזמור "יענך"
assignments.reason: The 70 voices are the cries of the nefesh of Beit Yaakov in galut — the holy Jewish soul crying out from under the dominion of the 70 nations. By essential nature, this is the soul of holy Israel in its exile state, corresponding to the 70 words of Mizmor Ya'ancha and the 70 nefashot of Beit Yaakov. These 70 souls are the Shivtei Yah (already in Package 1). The crying is the holy soul's act of separation from the evil nations — the same dynamic as kabalat ol malkhut shamayim. Its essential nature is the holy collective soul asserting its belonging to the divine kingdom.

The capacity to give birth (leileid) is essentially identical to Leidah (birth/revelation), which is already in Package 2. The Torah states 'hitgalut hi bechina leidah' — revelation IS birth. 'Efshar lah leileid' is the actualization of the mochin: the moment the concealed Torah-light emerges into the world. Its essential nature is the birth/revelation of divine intellect.

assignments.node_id: שעמד בנסיון ושבר הקלפה שקדמה לפרי
assignments.reason: Standing in the test and breaking the klipah is, by essential nature, the act of separating from the evil kingdom and joining the holy kingdom. In this Torah, the test is specifically ta'avat niuf (the klipah that precedes the fruit), and overcoming it means separating one's soul from the nishmateihen de-erev rav (Package 3) and including it in the Shivtei Yah (Package 1). This is the same essential dynamic as kabalat ol malkhut shamayim (already in Package 1) — the person's holy act of allegiance to the divine kingdom by rejecting the evil maidservant.

assignments.node_id: זכה לפרי. הינו להתגלות התורה שהיא חכמה ובינה
assignments.reason: This node explicitly names itself: 'the revelation of Torah which is chokhmah and binah.' Hitgalut, Torah, chokhmah, and binah are all already in Package 2. The essential nature is the attainment of divine intellect — the fruit (pri) that is the mochin themselves.

Tikkun habrit (rectification of the holy covenant) is, by essential nature, the sanctification of Yesod — the foundation that connects a person to the holy kingdom. The Torah states that tikkun habrit means separating from the isha zonah / malkhut haReshaya and binding oneself to malkhut shamayim. 'Mi she-mekadesh et atzmo mi-zot ha-ta'avah, azai hu nitkasher be-malkhut shamayim.' Its essential nature is holy consecration — the person's foundational act of belonging to the divine kingdom, the same domain as kabalat ol malkhut shamayim (Package 1).

assignments.node_id: יכול להבין ולתפס דבורו של הצדיק
assignments.reason: Understanding and grasping the tzaddik's speech is, by essential nature, the actualized state of the mochin — the intellect functioning in its completeness. The Torah states: 'ke-she-tikken ot brit kodesh ka-raui, azai ha-mochin shelo bi-shlemut, ve-yakhol le-havin dibburo shel ha-tzaddik.' The capacity to understand is the mochin themselves in their perfected, operative form. Its essential nature is divine intellect in action.
